baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ binds the act of turning away to a relied-upon strong side.
baseline_models.mechanism: Withdrawal is not solitary motion: the support phrase supplies the social or material base into which the ruler retreats, so refusal and power-preservation occur together.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal and aversion supply the outward motion whose backing the next phrase specifies.
A strong side relied upon supplies the power base carrying the withdrawal.
Inclining and settling toward something makes the support not merely possessed but trusted.

changed_reading.after: He withdraws while leaning into the strong side that sustains him, making the refusal relational and power-backed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The uttered disjunction سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ offers two labels in place of an answer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired labels close two explanatory routes: one relocates the force of the message into external deception, while the other relocates it into an internally covered mind. Either route discredits the messenger without engaging what was said.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech turns withdrawal into an overt classificatory response.
Diversion and deceptive alteration supply the external-cause label.
A reason covered by madness supplies the internal-incapacity label.

changed_reading.before: He adds one of two generic insults.
changed_reading.after: He deploys a two-route counter-classification: the message is either perceptual manipulation or the product of a covered mind, so its claim never reaches adjudication.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent scene sets sent message and manifest, compelling proof against the ruler's relied-upon side. The labels then function as a counter-authority produced when institutional force cannot answer evidentiary force.

activation_trace.role: The strong side supplies the ruler's answering base of power.
The deception label diverts attention from the proof to its alleged mode of influence.
The madness label diverts attention from the proof to the speaker's alleged incapacity.
Messenger and message supply the commissioned claim to which the ruler responds.
Compelling proof supplies an authority grounded in demonstration rather than entourage.
Manifest disclosure makes the proof difficult to treat as merely unavailable or obscure.

structural_cues: The adjacent verses oppose بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ to بِرُكْنِهِ, repeating an instrumental support frame with different bases.
The sequence is commission and disclosure, then supported turning, then discrediting labels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two adjacent instrumental frames and the proof-to-label sequence; I infer substitution of political force for evidentiary force. A live alternative is that ركن names only an entourage, without an epistemic contrast.

changed_reading.before: He retreats to his power and insults the messenger.
changed_reading.after: He answers manifest proof with a rival basis of authority: his support structure, protected by labels that convert evidence into deception or pathology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relied-upon side becomes concrete as a mutually supporting force, but ruler and force are seized and cast together. A later denial of standing and mutual aid generalizes the same limit: collective backing cannot keep its bearer upright.

activation_trace.role: The strong relied-upon side establishes the support whose performance the sequence tests.
Seizure removes the ruler from the control his strong side appeared to secure.
A mutually supporting host concretizes the social and military reach of the relied-upon side.
Casting ruler and host together reverses support into shared disposability.
Deserved blame assigns moral responsibility to the supported refusal.
Denied bodily standing supplies the later physical image of support failing.
Denied mutual aid extends failed support from posture to collective rescue.

structural_cues: In 51:40 the singular ruler and his troops are jointly seized, then referred to by a plural object when cast.
Verse 51:45 concerns a later people; its denied standing and aid is an analogical echo, not the grammatical referent of 51:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies troops, joint seizure and casting, then a separate denial of standing and aid; I infer that the pericope tests the function promised by ركن. The direct identification of ركن with the troops remains uncertain because it may include a wider power base.

changed_reading.before: His support accompanies his refusal but remains background.
changed_reading.after: His support is implicated in the refusal and shares its collapse: the protector and protected become one seized, discarded body.

context_deltas.mechanism: After failed human supports, the sequence presents a built, strengthened, expanding upper structure and a spread, prepared lower field. Against that scale, the ruler's ركن reads as a local counter-architecture that mistakes one dependent support for the frame of reality.

activation_trace.role: A strong side or structural support supplies the local architecture under comparison.
Ribs and supports by which a thing settles supply an explicit construction-scale analogue to ركن.
Supporting strength marks the larger construction as powerfully upheld.
Expansion beyond narrowness breaks the ruler's enclosed reliance on one side.
Spreading and leveling supplies the prepared lower plane of the larger architecture.
Preparation and setting an affair straight supplies ordered support rather than defensive leaning.

structural_cues: Verses 51:47-48 shift from collapsed peoples to an upper structure built with strength and a lower field spread and prepared.
The focus noun ركن already carries a structural-side image, allowing but not requiring this later material analogy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared support and construction imagery; I supply the contrast between a ruler's local structure and the larger created frame. The live alternative is that the creation passage begins an independent sign sequence with no backward pressure on ركن.

changed_reading.before: His ركن is simply the power beside him.
changed_reading.after: His ركن becomes a rival micro-architecture: a narrow support treated as ultimate even as the sequence opens onto the vastly stronger frame that contains it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope distinguishes three exits by direction and timing: the ruler turns with his support, hearers flee toward God, and the messenger is told to turn from persistent rejecters. Blame follows not motion alone but the attachment and stage of the motion.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the focus motion whose moral direction is later differentiated.
Settling toward a relied-upon side identifies the attachment governing the ruler's exit.
Flight supplies an urgent exit whose stated destination reverses the ruler's attachment.
The same turning-away branch becomes an authorized messenger action after repeated rejection.
Negated blame explicitly separates the messenger's turning from culpable withdrawal.

structural_cues: The directional frames differ: the focus has turning with a support, 51:50 has flight toward God, and 51:54 has turning from them.
The ruler is blameworthy in 51:40, while blame is negated from the messenger in 51:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched exit motions, different relational frames, and opposite blame values; I infer that endpoint, attachment, and completed warning determine moral valence. An alternative is that the later imperative only licenses tactical disengagement without commenting on the earlier verb.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is itself the ruler's defining fault.
changed_reading.after: Turning is morally indexed by where one goes, what one clings to, and whether warning has been heard: his fault is support-bound evasion, not locomotion alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact two-label formula reappears as the recurrent reception of messengers, then a question about mutual bequest frames its continuity as if socially transmitted. The ruler's utterance becomes one performance of a durable anti-message script sustained by collective overreach.

activation_trace.role: The recurring messenger role defines the repeated situation that elicits the same labels.
A saying spread among people turns the utterance from one speaker's reaction into a circulating formula.
The same diversion-and-deception classification supplies the first stable slot of the formula.
The same covered-reason classification supplies the second stable slot of the formula.
Exchanged bequest supplies the social-transmission image posed by the rhetorical question.
A people as a collective supplies the carrier of the script beyond any single ruler.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the shared disposition that reproduces the formula.
The non-dominant mapping's image of a people's voice makes the repeated formula audible as a collective chorus.

structural_cues: Verse 51:52 repeats قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ from the focus with plural speakers and an indefinite messenger pattern.
Verse 51:53 immediately asks whether earlier peoples mutually transmitted it, then answers by naming a shared collective disposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact verbal recurrence, pluralization, and the bequest question; I infer a reproducible social script rather than independent diagnosis. The live alternative, supported by the rhetorical force, is typological recurrence without literal historical transmission.

changed_reading.before: The ruler improvises a personal insult under pressure.
changed_reading.after: He voices a transhistorical anti-messenger script whose stable two slots let different power-holding groups neutralize disclosure without answering it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence contrasts two uses of voiced language. The ruler's labels close inquiry by fixing the messenger in a type; reminder reopens what can be held in mind and becomes beneficial where trust permits reception.

activation_trace.role: Voiced saying supplies the speech act that fixes the two discrediting labels.
Attributing what was not so sharpens the labels as imposed descriptions rather than demonstrated findings.
Bringing something back to mind supplies the cognitive opening opposed to classificatory closure.
Benefit rather than harm identifies the functional result of receptive reminder.
Trusting assent supplies the receptive condition under which reminder can work.

structural_cues: The command to turn from persistent rejecters in 51:54 is followed immediately by a command to remind in 51:55.
The focus speech ends in fixed predicates, whereas 51:55 names an ongoing cognitive effect in its recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labeling speech and later beneficial reminder; I infer opposed cognitive functions, closure versus reopening. A live alternative is that the focus simply reports abuse, with no deliberate anti-reminder strategy.

changed_reading.before: The two labels are merely hostile content.
changed_reading.after: The labels are a counter-speech technology: they arrest reconsideration precisely where reminder would restore a claim to active memory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل resolution for قَالَ and is form-distant from ordinary speech semantics. It remains anchored at the focus utterance and gains pressure from the preceding manifest proof; downstream prose should present it only as a latent affective resonance, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus قَالَ is packet-mapped not only to ق و ل but also to ق ل ل, where fear or anger can produce trembling.

activation_trace.role: Trembling from fear or anger supplies an unstable affective substrate beneath the apparently firm verdict.
Compelling proof supplies the pressure under which the ruler's classificatory certainty may tremble.
Manifest disclosure makes threatened reaction a plausible affective frame for the utterance.

changed_reading.before: He pronounces a stable diagnostic verdict.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory resonance level, the verdict may expose the fear or anger of threatened authority: the speech sounds firm while its packet-mapped underside trembles.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses two distinct branches of one root, cognitive covering and hidden beings. It remains valid as a packet-internal lexical contrast anchored in مَجْنُونٌ and the later ٱلْجِنَّ; downstream prose should describe a root resonance, not claim that the ruler consciously equates jinn with insanity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus label مَجْنُونٌ uses the same root later used for hidden beings, but the packet keeps the branches distinct.

activation_trace.role: Covering of reason supplies the disabling sense asserted by the focus label.
Hidden beings supply an ontological hiddenness that is not itself cognitive incapacity.
Manifest humanity contrasted with hidden beings establishes a difference of visibility rather than worth or purpose.
Shared worshipful obedience gives hidden and manifest creatures a common telos.

changed_reading.before: مَجْنُونٌ is only a generic allegation of madness.
changed_reading.after: The later branch contrast exposes the allegation as a misuse of hiddenness: it converts supposed covering into incapacity, while the surah can name genuinely hidden beings as purposive agents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the materially remote color-changing toy branch of س ح ر and pairs it with the later pairing image. It remains anchored in the explicit سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ alternation; downstream prose should mark it as a functional analogy, never as the ordinary sense of سَٰحِرٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus presents two labels joined by أَوْ, allowing the packet's reversible-display branch to model how the accusation changes face while preserving one defensive function.

activation_trace.role: A display that changes color when pulled from opposite sides supplies the material analogy for reversible accusation.
Covered reason supplies the alternate face shown when attack shifts from effect to agent.
A counterpart joined to its mate sharpens the two labels as a functional pair.

changed_reading.before: The ruler hesitates between two unrelated insults.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the accusation is a two-sided display: pull toward the message's effect and it shows sorcerer; pull toward the messenger's mind and it shows madness.

strongest_changes: The adjacent instrumental frames turn the scene into a contest between manifest proof and a ruler's relied-upon support.
The support shares the ruler's collapse, while the exact accusation recurs as a collective, reproducible anti-messenger script.
Later flight toward God and authorized turning from rejecters show that direction, attachment, and timing determine the moral force of turning.
summary.what_was_special: The packet preserved both exact verbal recurrence and branch-level reversals: the same turning can be blamed or blameless, the same accusation can circulate across peoples, and the non-dominant ق ل ل, hiddenness, and color-switching branches retain strange but anchored changed readings.
remaining_uncertainties: رُكْن may denote troops, a wider political base, personal force, or all three; the direct identification with the army is inferential.
The bequest question may mark typological sameness rather than literal transmission of one slogan.
The rival-architecture model and all three outliers should remain explicitly exploratory.
